newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita to sell 42-inch plasma TV in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita to sell 42-inch plasma TV in Japan.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Monday that it would start selling wide-screen televisions with a 42-inch plasma display in Japan on October 30.
The new plasma television will be sold for 1.5 million yen, the company said in a statement. Overseas marketing is also planned, it said.
The new product's plasma display is brighter and has higher contrast than existing products, Matsushita said.
The television's display is only 12 centimetres thick and can be hung on walls, the company said.
Several Japanese manufacturers have already launched 42-inch plasma display TVs, which are the largest plasma TV sets currently on the market.
